Sykes (Eastleight Town S.C.) and his team won the handicap team race which afforded Tommy Green much pleasure, for he has been at great pains to encourage the sport in his home town. Our "B" team, consisting of Brown, Coleman Latter and C.

Ted Jackman and Jim Latter had a determined struggle for second place, but Latter's earlier efforts in catching the leaders had sapped his strength, and Jackman was able to draw away in the last hundred yards.
